title: The AI Aerodynamicist, driven by an agent
description: The mission in words is read into objectives, limits and a budget (or refused with the reason), then an agent drives the Autonomous Physics Lab one controlled tool call at a time; its answer is audited against the ledger of OpenFOAM runs.

params.mission: Find a lower-drag aerodynamic design at 70 m/s. Preserve the required downforce, stay within the geometry constraints, and validate the final design using CFD. Use at most 20 CFD runs.
